title: [Subcontracting] Bug 640115: Fix Subc. Order FlowField so subcontracting orders are visible in Purchase Order List
summary: Fixed the Subc. Order FlowField to correctly identify subcontracting purchase orders so they display in the Purchase Order List view.
key_points: FlowField was incorrectly checking base table fields not set by the subcontracting flow
Changed CalcFormula to use the extension field Subc. Purchase Line Type instead
Subcontracting orders now visible in the Subcontracting Orders view
Aligns logic with existing SubcManufacturingCue table extension
Includes test to verify FlowField evaluates correctly after order creation
